evidence: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) was performed on films grown at 300 and 350 /C176C to determine their elemental compositions. The surface roughnesses of 45 nm thick Ta 2O5 films grown at 300 and 350 /C176C were probed by atomic force microscopy (Figure 8). X-ray diffraction (XRD) was carried out on films grown at 250, 300, 350, and 400 /C176C to assess film crystallinity. The index of refraction of several films grown at 325 /C176C was determined by ellipsometry.
